messages:
Priya (Support): Hey team — escalating INC-10234. Customer acme-inc reports spurious 403s that the client shows as "Invalid API key" when hitting POST /v1/generate. They downgraded plan yesterday. Here's their curl repro and raw response:

Priya (Support): ```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \n  -H "Authorization: Bearer sk_live_XXXX" \n  -d '{"model":"rwd-3b","input":"hello"}'
HTTP/1.1 403 Forbidden
Content-Type: application/json

{"error":"invalid_api_key","message":"Invalid API key"}
```

Priya (Support): Customer says they can reproduce from multiple machines. They attached account id: `org_78A9` and last successful call was ~12h before downgrade. cc @Aisha (billing)

Aisha (Billing): thanks. pulling billing records for org_78A9. Saw a plan change from `team-pro` -> `team-free` at 2026-03-14T18:02Z. Also seat count is 7, free plan caps at 5, so entitlement-service returns a block. I'm going to run the entitlement check now and paste response.

Aisha (Billing): ```json
GET /internal/entitlement/org_78A9
200 OK
{
  "org_id": "org_78A9",
  "plan": "team-free",
  "seats": 7,
  "status": "blocked",
  "reason": "over_seat_limit",
  "code": "ENT_SEAT_LIMIT"
}
```

Aisha (Billing): So entitlement is correctly blocking. Problem: downstream API is returning 403 but body is `invalid_api_key`. That mismatch is why support and the customer are confused.

Noah (Eng): hmm this is the old mapping case — api-gateway normalizes a bunch of 403s to a single `invalid_api_key` error for historic SDK compatibility. That was purposeful but it's causing these false auth tickets. We should surface a specific error code for entitlement-denied.

Noah (Eng): quick repro from our side:
```js
// gateway error handler snippet
if (!auth.ok) return 401
if (!entitlement.ok) return 403, { error: 'invalid_api_key', message: 'Invalid API key' } // <= current behavior
// proposed change:
if (!entitlement.ok) return 403, { error: 'entitlement_required', code: 'ENT_SEAT_LIMIT', message: 'Request blocked by plan entitlement: over_seat_limit' }
```

Noah (Eng): I can patch main to change the body for entitlement failures and add a new metric `entitlement.block_reason`. That will help support and downstream SDKs.

Grace (SE): From a customer comms POV we should:
- tell customer the 403 is from plan seat limits (not key rotation)
- offer a 7-day temporary trial to cover current seats or suggest downgrade steps to 5 seats
- update our docs page that covers 403 semantics (docs currently only mentions invalid keys and rate limits)

Priya (Support): I'll send a provisional reply: short, non-technical, with steps. Draft: "We saw your account changed plans and your current seat count exceeds the free plan. That triggers a protection which returns a 403. To restore access either reduce active seats to 5 or upgrade back to Team Pro. We're offering a temporary 7-day trial while you decide. Reply if you'd like us to enable it."

Aisha (Billing): ok enabling customer trial (one-time 7d override) now. toggling entitlement override for org_78A9 -> `trial_override:true`.

infra-bot: deploy request queued by @Noah (Eng): CI build #4092 -> canary. ETA ~10m. :rocket:

Noah (Eng): I'll follow-up with the small gateway change. Plan: patch -> canary -> 3h smoke -> roll to prod. Will include logging so the error body now contains `code` and `reason`.

Grace (SE): Can we also add a short SDK change: when 403 arrives with `code: ENT_*` surface a clear message instead of `Invalid API key`? Should be a small client-side mapping.

Priya (Support): Action items:
- Priya: send canned response and enable trial (done)
- Aisha: confirm override applied (pls post confirmation)
- Noah: deploy gateway fix canary + rollout (ETA today)
- Grace: draft SDK mapping PR and docs update

Aisha (Billing): override done. Entitlement now returns `status: active` for org_78A9. Customer confirmed access restored.

Priya (Support): Customer confirmed access is back. Marking INC-10234 as resolved in support UI pending Noah's follow-up change so we don't get recurring tickets from similar cases.

Noah (Eng): noted. I'll post the PR link after canary. Expect a short follow-up message once prod rolled.

Priya (Support): thanks everyone. Closing loop with customer and adding a note to runbook: "403 can mean entitlement block; check entitlement-service before assuming bad key" :white_check_mark:
